name: integration-hero
description: Integration detail page hero over the soft colour wash of the 2026 heroes. layout center: a centred eyebrow, a frosted card pairing the partner logo with the Asset Panda PRO mark, the H1, lede and one call to action (Figma: Integrations Detail Page Template > Hero Section, 7318:166961). layout split: the copy (eyebrow, H1, lede, button) left-aligned in the left column and the integration video on the right (poster + play, the player swapped in on click); the logo card then moves to the page body (integration-detail overview logo). Below 1025px the video stacks under the copy.

title.description: The H1, e.g. Slack + Asset Panda PRO. Line breaks are kept.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the logo card, e.g. Integrations.

logo.description: Partner logo URL (SVG preferred). Shown 64px tall on the left of the card; wide wordmarks are capped at 136px.

logo_alt.description: Alt text of the partner logo, e.g. Slack. Leave empty to treat the logo pair as decoration (the H1 already names both products).

brand_logo.description: Asset Panda mark on the right of the card. Empty uses the component's own Asset Panda PRO panda (assets/panda-pro.svg).

brand_logo_alt.description: Alt text of the Asset Panda mark. Only used when logo_alt is set, so the pair reads as one phrase.

lede.description: Paragraph under the H1 (max 680px, centred), e.g. the one-line summary of what the integration does. Line breaks are kept.

layout.description: center: the centred column with the logo card (the original template). split: copy on the left, the video on the right (no logo card in the hero; without a video the logo card takes the right column instead).

video_url.description: Split layout: the video — YouTube, Vimeo or an .mp4/.webm file. Without it the poster shows as a plain image.

video_poster.description: Split layout: poster image URL (16:9). It is the hero image, so it loads eagerly.

video_thumb.description: Split layout: what the video frame shows before play. poster: the video_poster image. logos: the partner + Asset Panda PRO logo card on the hero colour wash (drawn from logo / brand_logo, scales with the frame; video_poster is ignored), with the play button under the card.

video_title.description: Split layout: names the player and the play button, e.g. Hexnode + Asset Panda Pro integration video.

cta_label.description: Button text, e.g. Book a Demo. Renders only with cta_url.
